item.text: I’m re-reading the current files and repo state first so this pass can target the remaining cleanup instead of making cosmetic changes.

I’m splitting the demo entry point out of the utility class and tightening the internal conversion path. That keeps the API focused on prefix-sum computation and removes presentation logic from the core type.
I’m adding a dedicated demo class next so the utility no longer carries the sample `main` method.
I’m tightening the tests as part of the refactor: one shared exception helper, plus a check that the boxed-list path still fails cleanly on overflow.
The refactor is complete. I’m compiling all three classes and running both the regression harness and the new demo entry point to verify behavior end to end.

Refactored the codebase further.

What changed:
- Moved the sample `main` method out of the utility into [`/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/PrefixSumArrayDemo.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/PrefixSumArrayDemo.java)
- Kept [`/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/PrefixSumArray.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/PrefixSumArray.java) focused on computation only
- Removed the intermediate `int[]` allocation from the boxed-list path by boxing directly from the `long[]` core
- Added a small private validation helper for null input
- Cleaned up the test harness in [`/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/PrefixSumArrayTest.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/003_prefix_sum_array/PrefixSumArrayTest.java)
- Added overflow coverage for both the array and list APIs

Verified:
- `javac PrefixSumArray.java PrefixSumArrayTest.java PrefixSumArrayDemo.java`
- `java PrefixSumArrayTest`
- `java PrefixSumArrayDemo`

If you want another pass, the next useful step would be to put these into a proper package structure.
